_readme: Every row of coatue.com/portfolio read through the site's own /api/portfolio route (48 per page, keyed by the PortfolioGrid's Contentful id). initial_investment is the grid's 'Initial investment' filter (Venture | Growth), the firm's own claim about the round it entered; status_site is the grid's Active | Exit. No year, round word beyond the two-way split, or sector is published.
